data.name: Devalanth
data.gender_notes: Devalanth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devalanth is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ which means ‘God’ and ‘Alankara’ which means ‘abode’ or ‘dwelling’. In Hindu mythology, this name is believed to be associated with the divine abode of the gods. It symbolizes a connection to the divine and a spiritual journey towards enlightenment. The name Devalanth carries the meaning “God's Abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devalanth usually hope their child will grow to embody god's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
